title: Womennow Durga Puja & Diwali Festival 2026 In Cupertino (oct-18th)
description: Celebrate the Unity of Cultures at Womennow Durga Puja & Diwali Festival 2026
long_description:
Celebrate the Unity of Cultures at Womennow Durga Puja & Diwali Festival 2026
Mark your calendars for the grandest celebration of the year as Womennow Tv brings you a fusion of cultures with the Womennow Durga Puja & Diwali Festival 2026 on the 18th of October, 2026. Immerse yourself in the vibrant Hindi, Bengali, and Multilingual festivities, reflecting the spirit of Navratri and Dandiya. From traditional rituals to a spectrum of cultural performances, the festival is set to offer an unforgettable experience.
Embrace the Cultural Diversity at Womennow Durga Puja & Diwali Festival 2026
While the artist line-up for this grand event is yet to be announced, you can expect a selection of talented performers adding life to the festival. With a captivating mix of Hindi, Bengali, and Multilingual performances, the artists will ensure that the spirit of Navratri and Dandiya resonates throughout the day. Keep an eye out for the artist announcement to know who will be gracing the stage at the Womennow Durga Puja & Diwali Festival 2026.
Experience the Festivity at Monta Vista High School
The Womennow Durga Puja & Diwali Festival 2026 will take place at Monta Vista High School, located at 21840 McClellan Road, Cupertino, CA, United States. Known for its safe and accessible location, the venue also offers free parking for all attendees. To add to your experience, the vicinity is dotted with several Indian restaurants where you can enjoy a delicious meal before or after the event.
Grab your Tickets for an Unforgettable Celebration
Get ready for a day full of excitement with our Day Pass for the 18th of October, which includes Nabami & Dashami Puja, Sindoor Utsav & Visarjan Celebration from 11:00 AM–8:00 PM. Children under 5 can join the festivities for free, and free parking is available for all attendees. Enhance your experience with our Royal Bhog Thali, available separately for $10.00 after 1 PM. Don't forget to grab the Sindoor Thali, available for $10.00 with a valid event entry ticket.
